user.title: Set up NeoPill
user.description: Adds the NeoPill sidebar panel where you manage patients and medications. There is nothing to configure here.

abort.single_instance_allowed: NeoPill is already configured. Only one instance is allowed.

not_loaded.message: NeoPill is not loaded. Check Settings > Devices & services.

event_not_found.message: No NeoPill intake event with ID {id}.

assumi_farmaco.name: Take medication
assumi_farmaco.description: Records that a dose of a medication was taken, reducing its stock.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Amount taken. If omitted, the medication's configured dose is used.

segna_non_assunta.name: Mark as missed
segna_non_assunta.description: Declares that a scheduled dose was not taken, without reducing the stock.

rifornisci_farmaco.name: Restock medication
rifornisci_farmaco.description: Adds stock to a medication, either as a direct amount or as a number of packages (uses the package size configured on the medication).

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Units to add directly. Alternative to "packages".

packages.name: Packages
packages.description: Number of packages to add. Alternative to "amount".

segna_rifornimento_notificato.name: Mark restock as notified
segna_rifornimento_notificato.description: Declares that the user was already notified about one or more medications to reorder, so their "da_notificare" attributes go back to false until the situation changes. Call it from your automations right after notifying.

medication_id.name: Medication
medication_id.description: ID of a single medication to confirm. Alternative to "patient_id".

patient_id.name: Patient
patient_id.description: Patient ID: confirms all of their medications currently pending notification. Alternative to "medication_id".

correggi_assunzione.name: Correct intake to missed
correggi_assunzione.description: Turns a dose already recorded as "taken" into "missed", restoring the stock it consumed. Meant for a bulk "Take all" that included a medication already out of stock. The event ID comes from the stock-depleted notification (event "neopill_stock_depleted").

event_id.name: Event
event_id.description: ID of the intake event to correct.
